about_the_game:
Alka is a young bird who lives at the top of the Tree of Eternity. One day, she loses her balance and falls, waking up in a strange and dangerous place. To return home, she must overcome the obstacles in her path. Help Alka on her journey and guide her back to her nest.

Three Different Art Styles

Each world stands out with its unique design, creating a strong visual impact. These worlds are carefully crafted with elements such as color usage, lighting arrangement, and spatial layout, designed to leave a powerful impression on the viewer.

Unique and Challenging Levels

Each level offers a distinct experience and presents the player with a new challenge. These levels vary in difficulty, gameplay dynamics, and environmental design, providing a constantly changing pace and a fresh experience for the player.

Accessible Gameplay, Deep Mechanics

Players can quickly adapt to the basic mechanics, but mastering them requires time and practice. The system is built on a structure that is easy to learn but difficult to master, making the experience both accessible and deep.

Gravity Rotation Mechanic

The Gravity Rotation Mechanic allows you to rotate gravity to the right, left, up, or down. This transforms walls into paths and ceilings into floors. This mechanic is used in different ways in each level, offering the player new solutions. It keeps the pace of the game fresh and exciting.

name: Bitbird

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Celeron
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics

short_description: Bitbird is a 2D platformer where players manipulate gravity to overcome challenging levels. The game starts with monochrome pixel-art and evolves through 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit styles inspired by different gaming eras.
